final: WITH per_media AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY MediaTypeId) SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS avg_of_media_type_avgs, AVG(track_count) AS avg_of_media_type_counts FROM per_media
